stories.name: Harshal Gada
stories.role: Director, Onlinebecho Solutions India Pvt Ltd
stories.quote: ONDC is a game changer ecommerce platform that has allowed us to increase our brands to a national level. The user base of the ONDC Network is increasing multifolds month on month.

stories.name: Rahul Jaishwal
stories.quote: As a budding entrepreneur with little prior experience in the digital business ecosystem, ONDC Network and UdyamWell proved to be a true blessing in disguise… instilled in me the confidence to innovate and expand my product range.

stories.name: Sanjeev Bhardwaj
stories.quote: Compared to traditional private marketplaces, ONDC Network offers a more economical and transparent model, creating a level playing field and expanding opportunities for MSMEs and manufacturers across India.
